policies.title: Trinidad and Tobago ordinary passports: Grenada visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy nationality schedule lists Trinidad & Tobago as requiring no visitor visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Trinidad and Tobago passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The actively linked schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service and special-document routes are outside this classification.

policies.title: Trinidad and Tobago ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule expressly places Trinidad and Tobago in its no-visa visitor cohort for stays up to three months.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Trinidad and Tobago passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The Embassy's named no-visa cohort states a maximum tourist stay of three months.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, final admission and separate third-country-document waiver rules remain outside scope.

policies.title: Trinidad and Tobago ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's live Tourism Board nationality table states that Trinidad and Tobago visitors can obtain a 40-JOD visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Trinidad and Tobago passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The Tourism Board table says all non-Jordanians must register for a Gateway2Jordan QR code before departure.
Entry-point, admission and non-visitor categories remain governed by Jordanian authorities.
